summary.text: John Shubeck is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 16 since his appointment in September 2025 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
A farmer and U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he faces Democrat Tim Rhead, along with fellow Republican Lisa Bogue, for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia reports that John Shubeck served in the U.S. Marine Corps and lists his career experience as farmer.
It says Governor Larry Rhoden appointed him to the House on September 17, 2025, to replace former Representative Richard Vasgaard, and that he advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary.
